text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes had finally arrived.
On the way to Nakayama Racecourse,
Curren Chan—

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chaaan!!
Good luck in your race today~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for cheering for me♪
Curren will do her very best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna steal everrryone's hearts for myselfâª
So don't look away, okay!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!!
SO CUUUUUTE!!
She was enveloped in cheers that sounded almost like an angry roar...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, that was amazing~.
A lot of people cheered for me
at the racetrack too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Being right at the center of all this wild excitement
makes Curren so, so happy!♪

True, the excitement is higher than ever.
Or rather, the crowd's vibe feels
a little different...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If Curren gets to run in this...
I feel like I could become super cute!
choice_data_list: Still, why all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the "Ossu♪ Summer Training Series"!
Big Bro, don't tell me you haven't watched it yet~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the "Ossu♪ Summer Training Series"!
Big Sis, don't tell me you haven't watched it yet~?

The "Ossu♪ Summer Training Series"
is a new project recently started on "Curren Channel♪".

True to its name, these are videos about summer training camp and daily workouts,
making it a rather unique series on the purely-cute "Curren Channel♪".

I check every video as soon as it's uploaded,
but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Big Brother,
you checked it right away, so you didn't notice, huh?
As expected of Curren's number one fan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Big Sister,
you checked it right away, so you didn't notice, huh?
As expected of Curren's number one fan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then let me tell you! The 5th volume in the training series,
'Cutie Continent,' should be easy to understand!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... haa...!
One more, please!"

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"An exhausted Curren Chan.
Yet she grits her teeth and pushes herself beyond her limits..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Curren wants to become even faster.
Running, running—to move forward!"

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text: "(Trainer) What's the reason you push yourself that hard?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's... to become the person I want to be.
Because I want to show everyone the cutest Curren there is."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you know? Short-distance races are super
fun! I'm hoping Curren can be the reason
everyone comes to love them too—"

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
“Mastering cuteness.
Where does she aim to go from here?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes will start at 15:40
at Nakayama Racecourse. Please come see Curren when she's totally serious!"

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama Racecourse.
That's Curren's 'another race.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, if I do say so myself, it's a great edit!
And check this out, the total views on this training arc are—

"The 'Cute Continent' video I just watched was doing particularly well, with the comment section buzzing with activity.
Among the comments—"

""She really was prepared for this."
"Honestly, I wasn't paying attention before, but maybe I'll start cheering for her now.""

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Keep your eyes on Curren Chan in this year's Sprinters Stakes!"
...Look, that's what it says!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it has a huge effect, doesn't it?
To be honest, this training arc was quite a challenge for Curren, but...
choice_data_list: Those sincere feelings really hit home, huh.
Your sincere feelings really struck a chord.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Looks like it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, Curren led everyone
with pure charisma, and I thought that was enough.
But—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It didn't resonate with those looking for "drama."
In that case, Curren just has to show it to them.
The drama that she carries within herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as back then.
Do interviews, answer questions, and let people read the articles.
All I have to do is repeat it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren doesn't need to change.
Instead, I'll just "change" everything else.
...Right, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren doesn't need to change.
Instead, I'll just "change" everything else.
...Right, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—We managed to change how race fans on UmaTube see things.
Total success♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all that's left is to make a big splash in the race!
I don't wanna waste all this attention by flopping!

Curren Chan is full of confidence.
I thought that with this, she had no blind spots heading into the Sprinters Stakes, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright then,
I'll be in your care today!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice to meet you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Flower-chan was seriously adorable.

(—Nishino Flower.
A top-tier contender who will likely be Curren Chan's greatest obstacle in this race.)
choice_data_list: True, it's so heartwarming and adorable.
True, it's so heartwarming and adorable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it.
She's... far too 'cute'.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? On Umatter,
they call Flower-chan the "Bento Box Fairy".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The bento she makes are cute and
packed with nutrition. She recently burst into the
Insta-worthy bento scene and shot straight to the top...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Her Cutie Power is... 4.35 million followers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"This race...
might not be as easy as Curren thinks."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even so!
Curren is different now, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta go out there and prove
that Curren's the cutest of them all today♪
